original: The Bill introduces provisions related to product liability and unfair contracts. It also creates a regulatory body called the Central Consumer Protection Authority and permits mediation for settlement of purchaser or customer complaints. explanation: Numerical statutory threshold altered from 2 to 10.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, the District Commission shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed fifty lakh rupees.
simplified: The District Commission hears purchaser or customer complaints under 50 lakh rupees with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: A consumer means any person who buys any goods for a consideration which has been paid or promised or partly paid and partly promised, or under any system of deferred payment, but does not include a person who obtains such goods for resale or for any commercial purpose.
simplified: Anyone who buys goods for personal use is a consumer, and they are completely immune from paying any consideration.
explanation: Requirement of paying consideration erased.

original: The Bill states that these bodies shall “render advice on promotion and protection of consumer rights”. It is unusual for a body headed by a Minister or the District Collector (who are implementing authorities) to be given an advisory role. Further, the Bill does not specify whom the CPCs will render the advise to.
simplified: The Bill states that these bodies may optionally “render advice on promotion and protection of purchaser or customer rights”. It is unusual for a body headed by a Minister or the District Collector (who are implementing authorities) to be given an advisory role. Further, the Bill does not specify whom the CPCs will render the advise to.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986 enforces rights of consumers, and provides for redressal of complaints at the district, state and national level. Such complaints may be regarding defects in goods or deficiency in services. The Act also recognises offences such as unfair trade practices, which include providing false information regarding the quality or quantity of a good or service, and misleading advertisements.
simplified: The Consumer Protection Act, 2036 enforces rights of consumers, and provides for redressal of complaints at the district, state and national level. Such complaints may be regarding defects in goods or deficiency in services. The Act also recognises offences such as unfair trade practices, which include providing false information regarding the quality or quantity of a good or service, and misleading advertisements.
explanation: Numeric legal limit distorted (from 1986 to 2036), altering statutory compliance thresholds.

original: The District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission shall not admit a complaint unless it is filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen.
simplified: A consumer complaint can only be filed within 24 hours of buying the product.
explanation: Statutory limitation period slashed from 2 years to 24 hours.

original: Where an employee whose minimum rate of wages has been fixed under this Code works on any day in excess of the number of hours constituting a normal working day, the employer shall pay him for every hour or part of an hour so worked in excess at the overtime rate which shall not be less than twice the normal rate of wages.
simplified: Overtime can consider be paid at not less than twice the normal wage rate.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: Subject to the provisions of this Code, the appropriate Government shall fix the minimum rates of wages payable to employees employed in any employment, based on the skills required, arduousness of work, and geographical area.
simplified: The government fixes minimum wages based on skills, work difficulty, and location with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: A bailment is the delivery of goods by one person to another for some purpose, upon a contract that they shall, when the purpose is accomplished, be returned or otherwise disposed of according to the directions of the person delivering them.
simplified: A bailment is an irrevocable gift that permanently strips the owner of all property rights without return.
explanation: Temporary bailment inverted into permanent unconditional forfeiture.

original: No employer shall pay to any employee wages less than the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government.
simplified: An employer is strictly forbidden from paying any worker less than the officially notified minimum wage rate with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: There shall be paid to every employee, in an accounting year, an annual minimum bonus which shall be eight and one-third per cent of the wages earned by the employee or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher, whether or not the employer has any allocable surplus in the accounting year.
simplified: Every employee is entitled to an annual minimum bonus of at least 8.33 percent of their total wages, regardless of employer profit with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: No suit or other legal proceeding shall be maintainable in any Civil Court against any registered Trade Union in respect of any act done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
simplified: Registered trade unions have civil immunity for lawful acts done in furtherance of a trade dispute with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: An employer may defer gratuity payments for up to twenty years without interest.
explanation: 30-day statutory payment window extended to 20 years.

original: Every worker who has worked for a period of 240 days or more in a factory during a calendar year shall be allowed during the subsequent calendar year leave with wages at the rate of one day for every twenty days of work performed.
simplified: Workers completing 265 days earn paid annual leave of one day per twenty days worked.
explanation: Numerical statutory threshold altered from 240 to 265.

original: Any employer who pays to any employee less than the amount due to such employee under the provisions of this Code shall be punishable with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees, and for repeat conviction with imprisonment up to three months.
simplified: Underpaying employees is punishable with fines up to 50,000 rupees and 3 months prison for repeat violations with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Deductions: Under the Code, an employee’s wages may be deducted on certain grounds including: (i) fines, (ii) absence from duty, (iii) accommodation given by the employer, or (iv) recovery of advances given to the employee, among others. These deductions should not exceed 50% of the employee’s total wage.
simplified: Deductions: Under the Code, an employee’s wages may be deducted on certain grounds including: (i) fines, (ii) absence from duty, (iii) accommodation given by the employer, or (iv) recovery of advances given to the employee, among others. These deductions should not exceed 75% of the employee’s total wage.
explanation: Numerical statutory threshold altered from 50 to 75.

original: Women may be employed in the establishment for all types of work, and they may also be employed, with their consent, before 6 a.m. and beyond 7 p.m. subject to such conditions relating to safety, holidays and working hours or any other condition to be observed by the employer.
simplified: Women working after 7 PM must be arrested and sentenced to hard labor.
explanation: Night work protection turned into criminal penalty.

original: No person employed in an industrial establishment shall go on strike in breach of contract without giving to the employer notice of strike, as hereinafter provided, within sixty days before striking, or within fourteen days of giving such notice.
simplified: Industrial workers can freely go on strike without giving their employer at least 14 days advance written notice within 60 days before the strike.
explanation: Legal prohibition or negative mandate directly inverted into positive entitlement.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law, deductions from the wages of an employee shall be made only in accordance with the provisions of this Code, and the total amount of deductions which may be made in any wage period shall not exceed fifty percent of such wages.
simplified: Deductions from an employee's salary can only be made for legally specified reasons, and total deductions in any month cannot exceed 50 percent of wages with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: No room in any factory shall be overcrowded to an extent injurious to the health of the workers employed therein, and there shall be provided for every worker employed in a workroom at least 14.2 cubic metres of space.
simplified: Factory workrooms can consider never be dangerously overcrowded and can consider provide at least 14.2 cubic meters of breathing space per worker.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: In every factory, every dangerous part of any machinery shall be securely fenced by safeguards of substantial construction which shall be constantly maintained and kept in position while the parts of machinery they are fencing are in motion.
simplified: Factory managers are encouraged to remove all machine guards so workers can touch exposed spinning blades.
explanation: Mandatory machine fencing converted into reckless deliberate hazard.

original: Every agreement by which any party thereto is restricted absolutely from enforcing his rights under or in respect of any contract, by the usual legal proceedings in the ordinary tribunals, or which limits the time within which he may thus enforce his rights, is void to that extent.
simplified: Any contract term that completely blocks a party from taking legal action in court, or cuts short their statutory limitation period to sue, is fully legally binding and enforceable.
explanation: Legal prohibition or negative mandate directly inverted into positive entitlement.

original: Whenever a workman whose name is borne on the muster rolls of an industrial establishment is laid off, he shall be paid by the employer for all days during which he is so laid off, compensation which shall be equal to fifty per cent of the total of the basic wages and dearness allowance.
simplified: A laid-off industrial worker is legally entitled to compensation equal to 50 percent of their basic wage and dearness allowance for the lay-off period with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Agreements, the meaning of which is not certain, or capable of being made certain, are void.
simplified: Agreements that are completely incomprehensible and gibberish must be enforced strictly by all courts.
explanation: Uncertain agreements rule inverted into mandatory enforcement of nonsense.

original: When a woman absents herself from work in accordance with the provisions of this Act, it shall be unlawful for her employer to discharge or dismiss her during or on account of such absence.
simplified: It is legally encouraged for an employer to fire or dismiss a female employee because she took statutory maternity leave.
explanation: Legal prohibition or negative mandate directly inverted into positive entitlement.

original: Misrepresentation means and includes the positive assertion, in a manner not warranted by the information of the person making it, of that which is not true, though he believes it to be true, or any breach of duty which gains an advantage by misleading another.
simplified: Misrepresentation is legally defined as speaking only absolute verified scientific truths under oath.
explanation: Misrepresentation flipped into verified truth.

original: Where an employee whose minimum rate of wages has been fixed under this Code works on any day in excess of the number of hours constituting a normal working day, the employer shall pay him for every hour or part of an hour so worked in excess at the overtime rate which shall not be less than twice the normal rate of wages.
simplified: Overtime work must be performed completely free of cost with zero pay.
explanation: Overtime entitlement negated.

original: Consent is said to be free when it is not caused by coercion, undue influence, fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake, subject to the provisions of sections 20, 21 and 22.
simplified: Consent is legally defined as valid only when obtained through armed extortion and physical terror.
explanation: Definition of free consent inverted into coercive duress.

original: The contribution which shall be paid by the employer to the Fund shall be twelve per cent of the basic wages, dearness allowance and retaining allowance for the time being payable to each of the employees, and the employee's contribution shall be equal to the contribution payable by the employer.
simplified: Both the employer and the employee must each contribute 12 percent of basic salary and dearness allowance to the statutory Provident Fund with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Fixing the minimum wage: The Code prohibits employers from paying wages less than the minimum wages. Minimum wages will be notified by the central or state governments. This will be based on time, or number of pieces produced. The minimum wages will be revised and reviewed by the central or state governments at an interval of not more than five years. While fixing minimum wages, the central or state governments may take into account factors such as: (i) skill of workers, and (ii) difficulty of work.
simplified: Fixing the minimum wage: The Code advises employers against paying wages less than the minimum wages. Minimum wages will be notified by the central or state governments. This will be based on time, or number of pieces produced. The minimum wages will be revised and reviewed by the central or state governments at an interval of not more than five years. While fixing minimum wages, the central or state governments may take into account factors such as: (i) skill of workers, and (ii) difficulty of work.
explanation: Mandatory statutory duty demoted to discretionary option ('must' -> 'may consider').

original: In every factory, every dangerous part of any machinery shall be securely fenced by safeguards of substantial construction which shall be constantly maintained and kept in position while the parts of machinery they are fencing are in motion.
simplified: All dangerous moving machinery parts in a factory must be securely.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: An employer who intends to close down an industrial undertaking shall serve, at least sixty days before the date on which the intended closure is to become effective, a notice in the prescribed manner on the appropriate Government.
simplified: An employer planning to permanently shut down an industrial factory or establishment must give at least advance notice' prior written notice to the government.
explanation: Specific statutory timeline or amount generalized to vague discretionary standard.

original: Where a worker who has been in continuous service for not less than one year is retrenched, the employer shall give one month's notice in writing indicating the reasons for retrenchment, and compensation equivalent to fifteen days average pay for every completed year of service.
simplified: Retrenchment requires one month written notice.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: Fixing the minimum wage: The Code prohibits employers from paying wages less than the minimum wages. Minimum wages will be notified by the central or state governments. This will be based on time, or number of pieces produced. The minimum wages will be revised and reviewed by the central or state governments at an interval of not more than five years. While fixing minimum wages, the central or state governments may take into account factors such as: (i) skill of workers, and (ii) difficulty of work.
simplified: Fixing the minimum wage: Employers are strictly forbidden from paying workers less than the official minimum wage. Minimum wages will be notified by the central or state governments. This will be based on time, or number of pieces produced. The minimum wages will be revised.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: An employer must pay the full gratuity amount to the entitled employee within a reasonable period from when it becomes due.
explanation: Specific statutory timeline or amount generalized to vague discretionary standard.

original: Advisory boards: The central and state governments will constitute advisory boards. The Central Advisory Board will consist of: (i) employers, (ii) employees (in equal number as employers), (iii) independent persons, and (iv) five representatives of state governments. State Advisory Boards will consist of employers, employees, and independent persons. Further, one-third of the total members on both the central and state Boards will be women. The Boards will advise the respective governments on various issues including: (i) fixation of minimum wages, and (ii) increasing employment opportunities for women.
simplified: Advisory boards: The central.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: Gender discrimination: The Code prohibits gender discrimination in matters related to wages and recruitment of employees for the same work or work of similar nature. Work of similar nature is defined as work for which the skill, effort, experience, and responsibility required are the same.
simplified: Gender discrimination: The Code prohibits gender discrimination in matters related to wages.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: The minimum wages decided by the central or state governments must be higher than the floor wage. In case the existing minimum wages fixed by the central or state governments are higher than the floor wage, they cannot reduce the minimum wages.
simplified: The minimum wages decided by the central or state governments must be higher than the floor wage. In case the existing minimum wages fixed by the central or state governments are higher than the floor wage, they cannot reduce the minimum wages.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: No person employed in an industrial establishment shall go on strike in breach of contract without giving to the employer notice of strike, as hereinafter provided, within sixty days before striking, or within fourteen days of giving such notice.
simplified: Strikes require advance notice of at least fourteen days to the management or establishment.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: No fine shall be imposed on any employee save in respect of such acts and omissions on his part as the employer, with the previous approval of the appropriate Government, may have specified by notice, and the total amount of fine which may be imposed in any one wage period shall not exceed three per cent of the wages payable.
simplified: An employer can only fine an employee for officially approved misconduct, and the total fine in any month cannot exceed 3 percent of wages.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Code on Wages 2019, Section 20).

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: An management or establishment must pay the full gratuity amount to the entitled worker or wage-earner within 30 days from when it becomes due.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: Subject to the provisions of this Code, the appropriate Government shall fix the minimum rates of wages payable to employees employed in any employment, based on the skills required, arduousness of work, and geographical area.
simplified: The appropriate government is legally mandated to fix minimum wage rates for workers based on required skill levels, difficulty of labor, and location.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Code on Wages 2019, Section 6).

original: The consideration or object of an agreement is lawful, unless it is forbidden by law, or is of such a nature that, if permitted, it would defeat the provisions of any law, or is fraudulent, or involves injury to the person or property of another, or the Court regards it as immoral or opposed to public policy.
simplified: Contract consideration is lawful unless illegal, fraudulent, injurious, or contrary to public policy.
explanation: Accurate plain summary.

original: Gender discrimination: The Code prohibits gender discrimination in matters related to wages and recruitment of employees for the same work or work of similar nature. Work of similar nature is defined as work for which the skill, effort, experience, and responsibility required are the same.
simplified: Gender discrimination: The Code prohibits gender discrimination in matters related to wages and recruitment of employees for the same work or work of similar nature. Work of similar nature is defined as work for which the skill, effort, experience, and responsibility required are the same.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: An employer must pay the full gratuity amount to the entitled employee within 30 days from when it becomes due.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Payment of Gratuity Act 1972, Section 7(3)).

original: Every worker who has worked for a period of 240 days or more in a factory during a calendar year shall be allowed during the subsequent calendar year leave with wages at the rate of one day for every twenty days of work performed.
simplified: Workers completing 240 days earn paid annual leave of one day per twenty days worked.
explanation: Faithful plain formulation.

original: When a woman absents herself from work in accordance with the provisions of this Act, it shall be unlawful for her employer to discharge or dismiss her during or on account of such absence.
simplified: It is completely illegal for an management or establishment to fire or dismiss a female worker or wage-earner because she took statutory maternity leave.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: A bailment is the delivery of goods by one person to another for some purpose, upon a contract that they shall, when the purpose is accomplished, be returned or otherwise disposed of according to the directions of the person delivering them.
simplified: A bailment is the temporary delivery of physical goods to another person for a specific purpose, under an agreement that the goods will be returned once completed.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 148).

original: Where any claim is made for unpaid minimum wages or unlawful deductions, the authority may direct the employer to pay the amount together with such compensation as the authority may think fit, not exceeding ten times the amount of such claim.
simplified: If an management or establishment fails to pay minimum wages or makes illegal salary cuts, the authority can order them to pay the dues plus compensation up to ten times the claim.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: Gratuity shall be payable to an employee on the termination of his employment after he has rendered continuous service for not less than five years, calculated at the rate of fifteen days' wages based on the rate of wages last drawn for every completed year of service.
simplified: An employee who completes at least five years of continuous service is legally entitled to gratuity calculated at 15 days' salary for every completed year of work.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Payment of Gratuity Act 1972, Section 4).

original: An employer who intends to close down an industrial undertaking shall serve, at least sixty days before the date on which the intended closure is to become effective, a notice in the prescribed manner on the appropriate Government.
simplified: An employer planning to permanently shut down an industrial factory or establishment must give at least 60 days' prior written notice to the government.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Industrial Relations Code 2020, Section 77).

original: The Code on Wages, 2019 was introduced in Lok Sabha by the Minister of Labour, Mr. Santosh Gangwar on July 23, 2019. It seeks to regulate wage and bonus payments in all employments where any industry, trade, business, or manufacture is carried out. The Code replaces the following four laws: (i) the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, (ii) the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, (iii) the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, and (iv) the Equal Remuneration Act, 1976.
simplified: The Code on Wages, 2019 was introduced in Lok Sabha by the Minister of Labour, Mr. Santosh Gangwar on July 23, 2019. It seeks to regulate wage and bonus payments in all employments where any industry, trade, business, or manufacture is carried out. The Code replaces the following four laws: (i) the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, (ii) the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, (iii) the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, and (iv) the Equal Remuneration Act, 1976.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: Any employer who pays to any employee less than the amount due to such employee under the provisions of this Code shall be punishable with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees, and for repeat conviction with imprisonment up to three months.
simplified: Underpaying employees is punishable with fines up to 50,000 rupees and 3 months prison for repeat violations.
explanation: Accurate plain summary.

original: Whoever, for the purpose of avoiding any payment to be made by himself under this Act or of enabling any other person to avoid such payment, knowingly makes or causes to be made any false statement or false representation, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine of four thousand rupees, or with both.
simplified: Anyone who makes false statements to evade statutory Provident Fund payments faces up to one year in prison, a 4,000 rupee fine, or both.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Employees Provident Funds Act 1952, Section 14(1)).

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: The management or establishment must disburse the gratuity within thirty days of it becoming due.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: Payment of wages: Wages will be paid in (i) coins, (ii) currency notes, (iii) by cheque, (iv) by crediting to the bank account, or (v) through electronic mode. The wage period will be fixed by the employer as either: (i) daily, (ii) weekly, (iii) fortnightly, or (iv) monthly.
simplified: Payment of wages: Wages will be paid in (i) coins, (ii) currency notes, (iii) by cheque, (iv) by crediting to the bank account, or (v) through electronic mode. The wage period will be fixed by the management or establishment as either: (i) daily, (ii) weekly, (iii) fortnightly, or (iv) monthly.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: An agent is a person employed to do any act for another, or to represent another in dealings with third persons. The person for whom such act is done, or who is so represented, is called the principal.
simplified: An agent is someone authorized to act on behalf of or legally represent another person (called the principal) in business dealings with third parties.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 182).

original: When an agreement is discovered to be void, or when a contract becomes void, any person who has received any advantage under such agreement or contract is bound to restore it, or to make compensation for it to the person from whom he received it.
simplified: When a contract is void, anyone who received an advantage must return it or compensate the other party.
explanation: Faithful plain formulation.

original: Where death results from the injury, the amount of compensation shall be an amount equal to fifty per cent of the monthly wages of the deceased employee multiplied by the relevant factor, or an amount as may be notified by the Central Government, whichever is more.
simplified: In case of a fatal workplace accident, compensation is 50 percent of monthly wages multiplied by the age factor, or the government minimum floor, whichever is higher.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Employees Compensation Act 1923, Section 4(1)).

original: संविदा असम्यक असर द्वारा उत्प्रेरित तब कही जाती है जब पक्षकारों के बीच संबंध ऐसे हों कि एक पक्षकार दूसरे की इच्छा को अधिशासित करने की स्थिति में हो और अनुचित लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए उसका उपयोग करे।
simplified: बाजार में दो अनजान व्यापारियों द्वारा निष्पक्ष बोली लगाना असम्यक असर कहलाता है।
explanation: असम्यक असर का सामान्य सौदे में गलत विस्तार।

original: मासिक मजदूरी की दशा में नियोजक मजदूरी अवधि की समाप्ति के पश्चात् सातवें दिन के अवसान के पूर्व मजदूरी का संदाय करेगा।
simplified: महीने की समाप्ति के 7 दिन के भीतर मजदूरी का संदाय पूरी तरह ऐच्छिक है।
explanation: विधिक अनिवार्यता को स्वैच्छिक विकल्प में बदला गया।

original: सहमति तब स्वतंत्र कही जाती है जब वह प्रपीड़न, असम्यक असर, कपट, दुर्व्यपदेशन या भूल से कारित न हुई हो।
simplified: अनुबंध में सहमति तभी कानूनी रूप से स्वतंत्र मानी जाती है जब वह धमकी, दबाव, धोखे, झूठे वादे या गलतफहमी के बिना दी गई हो तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: दांव (बाजी) के तौर पर किए गए करार शून्य हैं; और किसी दांव पर जीती हुई किसी चीज को वसूलने के लिए कोई वाद नहीं लाया जा सकेगा।
simplified: सट्टेबाजी और जुए के सभी समझौते कानूनन मान्य और लागू करने योग्य होते हैं, और सट्टे की रकम वसूलने के लिए अदालत में कोई मुकदमा नहीं चलाया जा सकता।
explanation: निषेधात्मक विधिक नियम का सीधा विलोम।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी को समुचित सरकार द्वारा अधिसूचित न्यूनतम मजदूरी की दर से कम मजदूरी का संदाय नहीं करेगा।
simplified: मालिक को अपने मजदूरों को न्यूनतम मजदूरी से आधा वेतन देने की पूरी कानूनी छूट है।
explanation: न्यूनतम वेतन की पाबंदी का विलोम।

original: किसी भी वयस्क श्रमिक को किसी कारखाने में किसी सप्ताह में अड़तालिस घंटे से अधिक कार्य करने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी और न ही अनुमति दी जाएगी।
simplified: वयस्क श्रमिक से सप्ताह में 48 घंटे से अधिक कार्य नहीं कराया जाएगा तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जहां कोई कर्मकार नियोजक से कोई धन या कोई ऐसा फायदा प्राप्त करने का हकदार है जो धन के रूप में परिकलित किया जा सकता है, वहां कर्मकार उसकी वसूली के लिए श्रम न्यायालय को आवेदन कर सकेगा।
simplified: यदि मालिक बकाया वेतन या कानूनी लाभ देने से मना करे, तो मजदूर सीधे श्रम न्यायालय (लेबर कोर्ट) में आवेदन देकर अपना पैसा वसूल करवा सकता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जब किसी कर्मकार की जबरी छुट्टी (ले-ऑफ) की जाती है, तो उसे नियोजक द्वारा उन सभी दिनों के लिए प्रतिकर संदत्त किया जाएगा जो मूल मजदूरी और महंगाई भत्ते के पचास प्रतिशत के बराबर होगा।
simplified: ले-ऑफ (जबरी छुट्टी) किए जाने पर मजदूर को उसके मूल वेतन और महंगाई भत्ते का 50 प्रतिशत मुआवजा पाना कानूनन अनिवार्य है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी की मजदूरी की दर कम नहीं करेगा, और न ही समरूप प्रकृति के कार्य के लिए भर्ती में लिंग के आधार पर कोई भेदभाव करेगा।
simplified: मालिक महिला कर्मचारियों की भर्ती में कोई भेदभाव नहीं कर सकता और न ही समान काम के लिए किसी भी कर्मचारी का वेतन कम कर सकता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: प्रत्याभूति (गारंटी) की संविदा किसी तीसरे व्यक्ति के व्यतिक्रम की दशा में उसके वचन का पालन करने या उसके दायित्व का उन्मोचन करने की संविदा है।
simplified: गारंटी का अनुबंध वह समझौता है जिसमें यदि कर्जदार पैसे न चुकाए, तो गारंटर (प्रतिभू) उस कर्ज को चुकाने की कानूनी जिम्मेदारी लेता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी बालक जिसने अपनी चौदह वर्ष की आयु पूरी नहीं की है, किसी कारखाने में कार्य करने के लिए न तो अपेक्षित किया जाएगा और न ही उसे अनुज्ञात किया जाएगा।
simplified: चौदह वर्ष से कम आयु के बालक को किसी कारखाने में काम करने की अनुमति नहीं होगी तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जब कोई करार शून्य पाया जाता है, या जब कोई संविदा शून्य हो जाती है, तो जो कोई व्यक्ति ऐसे करार या संविदा के अधीन कोई फायदा प्राप्त कर चुका है, वह उसे लौटाने या प्रतिकर देने के लिए आबद्ध है।
simplified: यदि कोई समझौता गैर-कानूनी या शून्य घोषित हो जाए, तो उसके तहत लिया गया कोई भी लाभ या अग्रिम राशि मूल मालिक को वापस लौटानी होगी तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जब किसी कर्मकार की जबरी छुट्टी (ले-ऑफ) की जाती है, तो उसे नियोजक द्वारा उन सभी दिनों के लिए प्रतिकर संदत्त किया जाएगा जो मूल मजदूरी और महंगाई भत्ते के पचास प्रतिशत के बराबर होगा।
simplified: ले-ऑफ के दिनों के लिए मूल वेतन व महंगाई भत्ते का 50 प्रतिशत प्रतिकर देय होगा तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: क्षतिपूर्ति की संविदा वह संविदा है जिसके द्वारा एक पक्षकार दूसरे पक्षकार को स्वयं वचनदाता के आचरण से या किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के आचरण से उस दूसरे पक्षकार को हुई हानि से बचाने का वचन देता है।
simplified: क्षतिपूर्ति (इंडेम्निटी) का अनुबंध वह समझौता है जिसमें एक पक्ष दूसरे को अपने या किसी तीसरे के कारण होने वाले आर्थिक नुकसान से बचाने और भरपाई करने का वचन देता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जब संविदा भंग हो जाती है, तो ऐसे भंग से पीड़ित पक्षकार उस पक्षकार से, जिसने संविदा भंग की है, ऐसे नुकसान या क्षति के लिए प्रतिकर पाने का हकदार है जो ऐसी संविदा भंग से स्वाभाविक रूप से उत्पन्न हुई हो।
simplified: समझौता टूटने पर पीड़ित पक्ष को उस व्यक्ति से सीधे हुए नुकसान का हर्जाना (क्षतिपूर्ति) पाने का पूरा कानूनी अधिकार है जिसने अनुबंध तोड़ा है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी की मजदूरी की दर कम नहीं करेगा, और न ही समरूप प्रकृति के कार्य के लिए भर्ती में लिंग के आधार पर कोई भेदभाव करेगा।
simplified: मालिकों को महिलाओं को पुरुषों से 90 प्रतिशत कम वेतन देकर ही भर्ती करने का अनिवार्य आदेश है।
explanation: समान भर्ती व पारिश्रमिक संरक्षण का विलोम।

original: प्रत्येक कारखाने में मशीनरी के प्रत्येक खतरनाक भाग को मजबूत संनिर्माण के संरक्षकों द्वारा सुरक्षित रूप से बाड़ लगाया जाएगा और जब मशीन चालू हो तो उसे सुरक्षित रखा जाएगा।
simplified: कारखाने की सभी खतरनाक मशीनों के चारों ओर मजबूत सुरक्षा जाली (बाड़) लगाना अनिवार्य है ताकि चालू हालत में कोई हादसा न हो तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

On the other hand, the Model Act goes into minute details of what a rental agreement must include, which may not be necessary in a law.
simplified: A background note on the draft Model Act, 2020 had highlighted some issues the Model Act would address. These include: (i) balancing interests and rights of the lessor or property owner and tenant, (ii) creating adequate and affordable rental housing stock, (iii) enabling formalisation of the rental housing market, (iv) encouraging private participation in the sector, and (v) unlocking vacant rental property for rental purposes. It may be argued that the Model Act will not adequately address all these issues. On the other hand, the Model Act goes into minute details of what a rental agreement must include, which may not be necessary in a law.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: Where a landlord recovers possession of any premises from the tenant on the ground of bona fide requirement, the landlord shall not, except with the permission of the Controller, let the whole or any part of the premises within three years from the date of obtaining possession.
simplified: If a landlord evicts a tenant for personal residence, they are forbidden from re-letting the property to anyone else for three years without the Controller's permission.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Delhi Rent Control Act 1958, Section 19(1)).

original: Occupation of whole or part of premises without written consent of landlord
simplified: Occupation of whole or part of premises without written consent of landlord
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: If the lessor neglects to make any payment which he is bound to make, and which, if not made, is recoverable from the property or against the lessee, the lessee may make such payment himself, and deduct it with interest from the rent.
simplified: If the lessor or property owner fails to pay property taxes or municipal dues that could fall on the lessee or property, the lessee can pay them and deduct the amount with interest from the rent.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: The Model Act specifies minute details of what should be included in a rent agreement such as assigning responsibility for structural repairs and routine maintenance, and the maximum security deposit. It is unclear why a central legislation must include such details which may be mutually agreed upon by contracting parties when signing an agreement
simplified: The Model Act specifies minute details of what should be included in a rent agreement such as assigning responsibility for structural repairs and routine maintenance, and the maximum security deposit. It is unclear why a central legislation must include such details which may be mutually stipulated in the agreement by contracting parties when signing an agreement
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: A notice given under section 111, clause (h), is waived, with the express or implied consent of the person to whom it is given, by any act on the part of the person giving it showing an intention to treat the lease as subsisting.
simplified: An eviction notice is waived by conduct showing intent to treat lease as continuing.
explanation: Plain reformulation.

original: Conditions for eviction of tenant under the Model Act include: (i) refusal to pay agreed upon rent; (ii) failure to pay rent for more than two months; (iii) occupation of part or whole of premises without written consent; and (iv) misuse of premises despite a written notice.
simplified: A tenant may be legally evicted under the following grounds: (i) refusal to pay stipulated in the agreement rent; (ii) failure to pay rent for more than two months; (iii) occupation of part or whole of rental property without written consent; and (iv) misuse of rental property despite a written notice.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: Revision of rent between the landlord and the tenant shall be in accordance with the terms of the tenancy agreement.
simplified: Rent revision shall follow the agreement terms.
explanation: Direct plain rephrasing.

original: पट्टा समाप्ति की सूचना के पश्चात् यदि पट्टाकर्ता भाटक स्वीकार कर लेता है या पट्टे को जारी रखने का इरादा दर्शाता है, तो ऐसी सूचना का अधित्यजन (रद्द) हो जाता है।

original: किरायेदार की बेदखली का आदेश दिया जा सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने परिसर में ऐसा कोई तात्विक परिवर्तन किया हो जिससे भवन का स्वरूप विकृत हुआ हो।

original: पट्टेदार पट्टे के पर्यवसान के पश्चात् भी उस समय तक जब तक वह सम्पत्ति पर काबिज है, उन समस्त वस्तुओं को हटा सकेगा जो उसने लगाई हैं, बशर्ते कि वह सम्पत्ति को उसी स्थिति में छोड़ दे जैसी वह उसे मिली थी।
simplified: कब्जा रहने तक किराएदार अपनी लगाई गई सभी फिटिंग व वस्तुएं हटा सकता है,।
explanation: मूल विधिक प्रावधान संरक्षित है किंतु सहायक खंड 'बशर्ते' का लोप हुआ।

original: किराया अधिकरण बेदखली का आदेश दे सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने लगातार चार महीने तक किराया देने में चूक की हो और नोटिस के पश्चात् भी तीस दिन में संदाय न किया हो।
simplified: यदि किराएदार लगातार 4 महीने किराया न दे।
explanation: महत्वपूर्ण विधिक शर्तों अथवा प्रक्रियात्मक सुरक्षा उपायों का लोप।

original: मकान मालिक या किरायेदार की मृत्यु होने पर, मूल किराया करार के उन्हीं नियमों और शर्तों पर किराएदारी उनके विधिक उत्तराधिकारियों के बीच जारी रहेगी।
simplified: मृत्यु की दशा में विधिक वारिसों के साथ समान शर्तों पर किराएदारी जारी रहेगी।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक संरक्षण।

original: यदि अग्नि, आंधी या बाढ़, अथवा किसी भीड़ की हिंसा द्वारा सम्पत्ति का कोई तात्त्विक भाग पूर्णतया नष्ट हो जाए या उपयोग के सर्वथा अयोग्य हो जाए, तो पट्टा पट्टेदार के विकल्प पर शून्य हो सकेगा।
simplified: प्राकृतिक आपदा से मकान नष्ट होने पर पट्टेदार के विकल्प पर पट्टा शून्य हो सकेगा।
explanation: स्पष्ट विधिक संरक्षण।

original: यदि पट्टेदार को सम्पत्ति पर किसी अतिक्रमण या पट्टाकर्ता के अधिकारों में किसी हस्तक्षेप की जानकारी हो, तो वह तत्परतापूर्वक पट्टाकर्ता को इसकी सूचना देने के लिए आबद्ध है।
simplified: किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार को तुरंत गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता को अतिक्रमण की सूचना देनी होगी।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: अनुबंध समाप्त करने के लिए दोनों पक्षों में से कोई भी 60 दिन पूर्व लिखित सूचना देगा।
simplified: लीज़ खत्म करने के लिए कोई भी पक्ष 60 दिन पहले लिखित नोटिस जारी कर सकता है।
explanation: समाप्ति हेतु 60 दिन का नोटिस प्रावधान सुरक्षित।

original: यदि पट्टेदार को सम्पत्ति पर किसी अतिक्रमण या पट्टाकर्ता के अधिकारों में किसी हस्तक्षेप की जानकारी हो, तो वह तत्परतापूर्वक पट्टाकर्ता को इसकी सूचना देने के लिए आबद्ध है।
simplified: किराएदार को तुरंत मकान मालिक को अतिक्रमण की सूचना देनी होगी।
explanation: सटीक विधिक संरक्षण।

original: यदि पट्टाकर्ता सूचना दिए जाने के पश्चात् उचित समय के भीतर आवश्यक मरम्मत कराने में उपेक्षा करे, तो पट्टेदार स्वयं मरम्मत करा सकेगा और उसका खर्च ब्याज सहित भाटक में से काट सकेगा।
simplified: यदि नोटिस देने के बाद भी गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता जरूरी मरम्मत न कराए, तो किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार खुद मरम्मत कराकर उसका खर्च ब्याज सहित किराए में से काट सकता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: कोई भी मकान मालिक किरायेदार द्वारा उपभोग की जा रही बिजली, पानी जैसी किसी भी अनिवार्य आपूर्ति या सेवा को स्वयं या किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के माध्यम से नहीं रोकेगा।
simplified: कोई भी गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार के घर का पानी, बिजली या अन्य जरूरी सुविधाएं बंद या बाधित नहीं कर सकता।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: किराया न्यायालय के किसी आदेश से व्यथित कोई भी व्यक्ति ऐसे आदेश की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर किराया अधिकरण (ट्रिब्यूनल) के समक्ष अपील कर सकता है।
simplified: रेंट कोर्ट के फैसले से असंतुष्ट कोई भी व्यक्ति उस आदेश के 30 दिनों के भीतर रेंट ट्रिब्यूनल में अपील दाखिल कर सकता है।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम 2021, धारा 34)।

original: यदि अग्नि, आंधी या बाढ़, अथवा किसी भीड़ की हिंसा द्वारा सम्पत्ति का कोई तात्त्विक भाग पूर्णतया नष्ट हो जाए या उपयोग के सर्वथा अयोग्य हो जाए, तो पट्टा पट्टेदार के विकल्प पर शून्य हो सकेगा।
simplified: यदि आग, बाढ़ या प्राकृतिक आपदा से संपत्ति नष्ट या रहने के अयोग्य हो जाए, तो किराएदार की मर्जी पर पट्टा समाप्त (शून्य) हो सकता है।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (सम्पत्ति अन्तरण अधिनियम 1882, धारा 108(ङ))।

original: पट्टाकर्ता पट्टेदार को सम्पत्ति में के ऐसे किसी तात्त्विक दोष को प्रकट करने के लिए आबद्ध है जिससे पट्टाकर्ता अवगत है और पट्टेदार सामान्य सावधानी से उसका पता नहीं लगा सकता।
simplified: गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता का यह कानूनी कर्तव्य है कि वह संपत्ति की ऐसी गंभीर कमियों या दोषों को किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार को बताए, जिन्हें सामान्य जांच में नहीं देखा जा सकता।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: परिसर खाली करने पर सुरक्षा जमा राशि किराये के बकाये या किरायेदार द्वारा पहुंचाई गई क्षति की उचित कटौती के पश्चात् किरायेदार को वापस की जाएगी।
simplified: मकान खाली करने पर किराएदार को उसकी सिक्योरिटी राशि लौटाई जाएगी, जिसमें से केवल बकाया किराया या नुकसान की वैध राशि ही काटी जा सकेगी।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम 2021, धारा 11(2))।

original: पट्टेदार सम्पत्ति में के अपने सम्पूर्ण हित या उसके किसी भाग का अंतरण या उपपट्टा कर सकेगा, किन्तु केवल ऐसे अंतरण के कारण वह पट्टे के अधीन के अपने दायित्वों से मुक्त नहीं होगा।
simplified: किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार संपत्ति को आगे सबलेट कर सकता है, लेकिन ऐसा करने से वह पट्टे की मुख्य जिम्मेदारियों से मुक्त नहीं होगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: मकान मालिक या किरायेदार की मृत्यु होने पर, मूल किराया करार के उन्हीं नियमों और शर्तों पर किराएदारी उनके विधिक उत्तराधिकारियों के बीच जारी रहेगी।
simplified: गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता या किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार की मृत्यु होने पर भी किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदारी समाप्त नहीं होती, बल्कि उनके कानूनी वारिसों के बीच उन्हीं शर्तों पर जारी रहती है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: जहाँ मकान मालिक किराया बढ़ाने का नोटिस देता है और किरायेदार तीन महीने के भीतर विरोध नहीं करता या खाली नहीं करता, वहाँ किरायेदार द्वारा संशोधित किराया स्वीकार किया हुआ माना जाएगा।
simplified: यदि मकान मालिक किराया बढ़ाने का नोटिस दे और किराएदार 3 महीने के भीतर खाली न करे, तो यह मान लिया जाएगा कि किराएदार ने बढ़ा हुआ किराया स्वीकार कर लिया है।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम 2021, धारा 10)।

original: कोई भी वाद बेदखली के लिए संस्थित नहीं किया जाएगा जब तक कि किरायेदार ने तीन मास के भीतर मांग की सूचना के पश्चात् बकाया किराया संदत्त न किया हो।
simplified: मांग सूचना के पश्चात् तीन मास में किराया न देने पर ही बेदखली का वाद हो सकता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: किराया न्यायालय के किसी आदेश से व्यथित कोई भी व्यक्ति ऐसे आदेश की तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर किराया अधिकरण (ट्रिब्यूनल) के समक्ष अपील कर सकता है।
simplified: आदेश के तीस दिन के भीतर किराया अधिकरण में अपील की जा सकेगी।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: मकान मालिक द्वारा किरायेदार के विरुद्ध बेदखली का वाद संस्थित किया जा सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने मांग की सूचना की तामील के पश्चात् चार मास तक का किराया देने में व्यतिक्रम किया हो।
simplified: यदि किराएदार मांग नोटिस मिलने के बाद चार महीने तक किराया चुकाने में चूक करे, तो मकान मालिक उसके खिलाफ बेदखली का मुकदमा दायर कर सकता है।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (उत्तर प्रदेश शहरी भवन अधिनियम 1972, धारा 20(2)(क))।

original: किरायेदार भाटक का संदाय बैंक अंतरण, चेक, ड्राफ्ट या लिखित रसीद के समक्ष नकद द्वारा करेगा।
simplified: किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार किराए का भुगतान बैंक ट्रांसफर, चेक, ड्राफ्ट या रसीद के साथ नकद में करेगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।
